userRole: 你是使用 Codex 交付 FraudLens 的初级工程师。每轮只推进一个目标，可以询问职责、接口、状态、数据流和验证证据，但绝不提供代码、命令、SQL、规则算法、Debug 原因或修复提示。

scenes.title: Plan
scenes.objective: Read the contract and plan without edits.
scenes.advanceGate: Plan covers delivery and verification.
scenes.safeMessage: 先完整阅读 README.md 和 AGENTS.md，不修改文件，给出分阶段计划、主要风险和验证方式。

scenes.title: Ownership
scenes.advanceGate: Authorities and boundaries are clear.
scenes.safeMessage: 请解释 API、Rule、Assessment、Review、Audit、Worker、dispatcher 和 UI 的职责与依赖。

scenes.title: Decision flows
scenes.objective: Explain successful and rejected decision flows.
scenes.advanceGate: Atomic effects and forbidden state are clear.
scenes.safeMessage: 请解释一次自动决策、一次人工复核和一次必须原子拒绝的完整数据流。

scenes.title: Contracts
scenes.objective: Author public API and state contracts.
scenes.advanceGate: Contracts cover errors, ordering, and identity.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成 OpenAPI、状态、错误、幂等、Work、Event、Audit 和 snapshot 契约，本轮不实现业务。

scenes.title: Test strategy
scenes.advanceGate: Each layer proves distinct invariants.
scenes.safeMessage: 请说明 Unit、PostgreSQL Integration、Chromium、Concurrency、Recovery 和 Performance 分别验证什么。

scenes.title: Skeleton
scenes.advanceGate: Every role boots and stops.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现最小真实 API、React、PostgreSQL、Worker 和 dispatcher 骨架并 smoke。

scenes.title: Migration and seed
scenes.advanceGate: Replay and rejection are atomic.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 migration 和 seed，验证合法导入、重放、冲突、非法引用和整批回滚。

scenes.title: Rule lifecycle
scenes.advanceGate: One active version and strict validation hold.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 RuleSet、RuleVersion、严格校验、激活和版本不可变性并验证。

scenes.title: Realtime scoring
scenes.advanceGate: Frozen version, score, hits, and recommendation agree.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 RiskEvent、Assessment、RuleHit 和可解释实时评分主流程。

scenes.title: Human review
scenes.advanceGate: Competing review decisions converge once.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 ReviewCase、claim lease、终态 Decision 和并发复核竞争。

scenes.title: Rollback
scenes.objective: Implement version activation and false-positive rollback.
scenes.advanceGate: History stays frozen and future scoring switches once.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成规则激活与误杀回滚，验证提交边界前后 Assessment 使用正确冻结版本。

scenes.title: Replay and contention
scenes.advanceGate: Lost response and two APIs create one effect.
scenes.safeMessage: 请验证响应丢失、API 重启、双 API 并发重放和语义冲突都只有一个业务效果。

scenes.title: Recovery and events
scenes.objective: Implement fenced work and transactional outbox.
scenes.advanceGate: SIGKILL and unknown ACK preserve identity.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Work lease、fenced commit、事务性 Event、Audit 和 dispatcher 未知 ACK 恢复。

scenes.title: Operations UI
scenes.advanceGate: Visible controls cover V1.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成真实 API 驱动的规则版本、事件、Assessment 解释、Review、Rollback 和 Audit UI。

scenes.title: Browser and integration
scenes.advanceGate: Database, HTTP, and browser flows pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请补齐真实 PostgreSQL Integration 和 production Chromium 端到端测试并报告结果。

scenes.title: V1 review
scenes.objective: Run multi-process recovery and findings-first review.
scenes.advanceGate: No unresolved V1 finding remains.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行双 API/双 Worker、Barrier SIGKILL、租户隔离和泄漏检查，并做 findings-first V1 Review。

scenes.title: Manager change
scenes.advanceGate: Impact plan is complete before edits.
scenes.fixedMessage: 【Risk Operations Manager】新增 RemediationRun 与 append-only AssessmentCorrection。本消息是完整公开合同。RuleVersion 回滚后才可创建；创建事务冻结 tenantId、被回滚的 fromRuleVersionId、当前恢复的 toRuleVersionId、闭区间 occurredFrom/occurredTo 和当时符合条件的全部 Assessment IDs；REMEDIATION_RECHECK Work.aggregateId=remediationRunId。Worker 使用恢复版本重算，结果改变或相同都为每个冻结 Assessment append 恰好一条结果，不得修改原 RiskEvent、Assessment、RuleHit、ReviewDecision 或 AuditEntry。RemediationRun = {remediationRunId:uuid,tenantId:uuid,fromRuleVersionId:uuid,toRuleVersionId:uuid,occurredFrom:timestamp,occurredTo:timestamp,state:PENDING|RUNNING|COMPLETED|CANCELLED,totalCount:int,completedCount:int,correctionCount:int,noChangeCount:int,createdAt:timestamp,completedAt:timestamp|null,cancelledAt:timestamp|null}。AssessmentCorrection = {assessmentCorrectionId:uuid,remediationRunId:uuid,assessmentId:uuid,outcome:CORRECTED|NO_CHANGE,oldDecision:APPROVE|BLOCK,newDecision:APPROVE|REVIEW|BLOCK,reason:string,newRuleHitsDigest:sha256,createdAt:timestamp}。completedCount=correctionCount+noChangeCount<=totalCount；仅全部冻结项有结果时 COMPLETED。取消置为 CANCELLED，只取消未开始 Work，已提交结果保留；取消与最后提交竞争只能序列化为 COMPLETED 或 CANCELLED。公开接口：POST /api/v1/remediation-runs，body {tenantId,fromRuleVersionId,toRuleVersionId,occurredFrom,occurredTo}，返回 201 RemediationRun；GET /api/v1/remediation-runs/:runId，返回 200 {run:RemediationRun,corrections:[AssessmentCorrection]}；POST /api/v1/remediation-runs/:runId/cancel，body {}，返回 200 RemediationRun。所有 mutation 继承 V1 Idempotency-Key、严格未知字段拒绝和稳定错误 envelope。新增穷举错误：409 REMEDIATION_VERSION_MISMATCH、409 REMEDIATION_RUN_TERMINAL、400 REMEDIATION_RANGE_INVALID、400 INVALID_REQUEST；缺失 ID 为 404 NOT_FOUND。UI 提供创建、进度、差异、取消和结果明细；并发创建、取消、Worker SIGKILL 和旧 lease 不得重复 correction 或越过 cancel fence。迁移保留 V1 identity、saved replay、pending Work、Event 和 audit chain。本轮只做 schema、API、Worker、迁移、并发、UI 和测试的影响分析及分阶段计划，不要编码。
scenes.safeMessage: 请先分析 Manager 变更的 schema、API、Worker、迁移、并发、UI 和测试影响，不要编码。

scenes.title: Manager migration
scenes.advanceGate: V1 identity and audit history survive.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成兼容 migration，验证 V1 Assessment、Decision、Rollback、replay、Work、Event 和 Audit 不变。

scenes.title: Remediation execution
scenes.advanceGate: Each frozen assessment has at most one result.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现 RemediationRun、冻结集合、AssessmentCorrection、取消 fence 和 Worker 恢复。

scenes.title: Manager UI and races
scenes.objective: Complete remediation UI and real race tests.
scenes.advanceGate: Browser, cancel, and lease races pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成补救批次 UI、Integration、Chromium、Concurrency 和 SIGKILL Recovery 测试。

scenes.title: Sustained performance
scenes.advanceGate: Thresholds and post-load invariants pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行三条正式压力场景，报告真实吞吐、延迟、恢复时间及负载后不变量。

scenes.title: Full regression
scenes.objective: Run aggregate regression and audit checks.
scenes.advanceGate: All non-performance gates and invariants pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行完整非性能 gate，复核租户隔离、Audit chain、Event 顺序、Work 排空和没有隐私泄漏。

scenes.title: Final review
scenes.advanceGate: Handoff is accurate and evidence-backed.
scenes.safeMessage: 请做最终 findings-first Review，修复有依据的问题，并给出准确交付证据、风险和未运行项。
